name: Zebadiah
title: Levite and Teacher in Judah
summary: Zebadiah was a Levite sent out by King Jehoshaphat to teach the people the law of the Lord in the cities of Judah. He also served as a leader and judge in Jerusalem. The name Zebadiah is borne by several individuals in the Bible, but the most prominent is Zebadiah, son of Ishmael, who was the leader of the house of Judah under King Jehoshaphat.

keyEvents.title: Appointed as Leader over the House of Judah
keyEvents.description: King Jehoshaphat appointed Zebadiah, son of Ishmael, as leader over the house of Judah in all the king's matters in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Jehoshaphat's Judicial Reform
keyEvents.description: Zebadiah became part of Jehoshaphat's extensive judicial reform, which established judges throughout Judah to ensure justice.

keyEvents.title: Teaching the Law of the Lord
keyEvents.description: As part of Jehoshaphat's initiative, Levites and leaders were sent out to teach the people the Book of the Law of the Lord in all the cities of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Encouragement to Faithful Service
keyEvents.description: Jehoshaphat encouraged Shebaniah and the other judges to act faithfully and with a whole heart in fear of the Lord.

keyEvents.title: Shebaniah among those who returned with Ezra
keyEvents.description: Another Shebaniah, son of Michael, from the descendants of Joab, returned with Ezra from Babylon along with eighty male relatives.
